title: Social Media Lead
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Open to hiring remote across the US - we also have offices in New York, San Francisco, Seattle, London, Paris, and Tel Aviv.

We're looking for a Social Media Lead to build the strategy and operating model behind how Runway shows up on social. Our audience spans filmmakers, artists, developers, researchers and enterprise teams, and each of them comes to our channels for something different. Your job is to give every channel a clear role and make sure our biggest moments, from model launches and research releases to film festivals and conferences, land with real distribution behind them.

You'll bring a strong point of view on where Runway should show up and how. You'll help our researchers, engineers, creatives and executives share the work closest to them with credibility and authenticity, and you'll treat our community of creators as collaborators in telling the story. You'll be hands-on where it matters, but this role is defined by strategic leadership and operational ownership.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Set Runway's social strategy, raise the creative bar and build the calendar around a steady, always-on presence that leads into our biggest launches

- Define a distinct role for each channel across X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and emerging community platforms

- Decide when Runway, a researcher, an executive, a creator, a customer or a partner should lead the story, then build the distribution plan around it

- Partner with Research, Product, Comms and Brand to turn model launches, research papers and product updates into native, credible social moments

- Help Runway researchers, engineers and executives post about their work, with clear guidance, coaching and coordinated amplification

- Work with our Community team, partners and our broader creator community to put the work made with Runway at the center of our channels

- Establish a clear scorecard and use social insights to sharpen the work over time

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Social runs on data-driven goals across reach, awareness, demand, campaign lift and audience insight

- Runway has a clear social point of view and a defined role for each channel

- Social is a strategic driver of visibility, creative adoption and demand, not an internal posting service

- Runway's researchers, engineers and executives have an easy, trusted way to share their work, and the strongest posts get coordinated amplification

- Creators see Runway's channels as the best place for their work to be seen

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 5+ years of experience in strategic social or related marketing programs; 2+ years at a top-tier technology, consumer, media or entertainment company is a plus

Toimit sähkösuunnittelijoiden teknisenä tukena ja pidät projektin suunnittelun langat käsissäsi aina piirustusten tarkastamisesta suunnittelun etenemisen seurantaan.
Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa

• sähköasemaprojektin sähkösuunnittelun koordinointi

• sähkösuunnittelijoiden työn ohjaaminen ja tekninen tukeminen

• eri suunnitteluosapuolten välisen yhteistyön koordinointi

• teknisten kysymysten ja suunnitteluun liittyvien haasteiden ratkaiseminen

Mitä odotamme sinulta?
Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa ymmärrystä sähköasemaprojekteista ja niiden teknisistä kokonaisuuksista. Tekninen taustasi auttaa sinua ymmärtämään projektien tarpeita, arvioimaan tarvittavaa osaamista ja tukemaan tiimisi asiantuntijoita heidän tehtävissään.
Odotamme sinulta:

• sähköinsinöörin (AMK/DI) tai vastaavaa teknistä koulutusta

• hyvää sähköpiirustusten ja teknisen dokumentaation tuntemusta

• Fingridin teknisten vaatimusten ja suunnitteluohjeiden tuntemusta

• kykyä hahmottaa laajoja teknisiä kokonaisuuksia ja viedä niitä järjestelmällisesti eteenpäin

• valmiutta ottaa vastuuta suunnittelun laadusta ja aikataulussa pysymisestä

Miksi Tekniq ?
Tekniq illä työskentelet vaativien sähkö- ja energiahankkeiden parissa. Asiakasprojektien vaihtuessa myös työn sisältö, toimintaympäristö ja ratkaistavat tekniset kysymykset vaihtuvat. Yhdessä projektissa painopiste voi olla suunnittelun koordinoinnissa, toisessa teknisten ratkaisujen arvioinnissa tai suunnitelmien tarkastamisessa. Erilaiset hankkeet tuovat työhön vaihtelua ja haastavat hyödyntämään osaamistasi uusissa tilanteissa.
Pääsuunnittelijana saat paljon vapautta vaikuttaa omaan työhösi ja työtapoihisi. Kokeneena asiantuntijana voit hyödyntää omaa näkemystäsi ja kokemustasi siinä, miten viet suunnittelua eteenpäin. Vapauden mukana tulee myös vastuu: pidät huolen siitä, että suunnittelukokonaisuus, tekninen laatu ja aikataulu pysyvät hallinnassa.
Työn tekemisessä joustavuus näkyy myös käytännössä. Tekniq in toimistot sijaitsevat Vaasassa ja Tampereella, mutta tehtävä ei ole sidottu kumpaankaan paikkakuntaan, vaan voit työskennellä joustavasti eri puolilta Suomea.

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.
Jätä hakemuksesi ja CV:si ainoastaan virallisen rekrytointikanavamme kautta. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

title: Senior Power System Protection Engineer

Overview
We are designing the grid of the future!
Conduct power system studies and analysis to meet regulatory compliance requirements for existing and future NERC and regional reliability standards. This role focuses on power system protection schemes and studies, ensuring protection coordination, and disturbance monitoring capability to adequately support the safety and reliability of the bulk electric system.
The successful candidate for this position has a strong background in power systems with emphasis in protection and control, including experience with industry standards and tools for power system protection. The successful candidate is familiar with protective functions commonly used for conventional and non-conventional generating units and can effectively utilize that knowledge and background in a demanding environment. 
Responsibilities
How you can make an impact:

• Perform power system protection studies using software (e.g., ETAP, ASPEN OneLiner), including short-circuit analysis and protection coordination for transmission systems and generation facilities.

• Review and evaluate existing protection systems, relay settings, and coordination practices to identify potential issues and recommend improvements.

• Evaluate Digital Fault Recorder (DFR), SCADA, and substation monitoring systems to assess existing capabilities, configurations, and data recording functionality against regulatory requirement (e.g., NERC PRC-028 and ERCOT NOGRR255).

• Conduct gap assessments of clients’ existing disturbance monitoring systems installed onsite (including DDR and FR capabilities,) and recommend improvements to meet applicable technical requirements.

• Support clients in NERC compliance activities, including NERC PRC-002, PRC-019, PRC-024, PRC-027, PRC-028, and other relevant standards.

• Prepare engineering calculations following established principles and methods, while managing assigned budget, schedule, and quality standards. Lead projects by delegating appropriate tasks to junior-level team members and coordinating team efforts for successful completion.

• Provide subject matter expertise and mentorship to junior-level engineers on protection engineering best practices.

• Develop and maintain process documentation, flow charts, working instructions, and other materials necessary for the continuity and success of the projects. 

• Leads process improvement efforts, identifying opportunities to enhance organizational efficiency while maximizing team bandwidth and ensuring the quality and timeliness of client deliverables. 

Qualifications
Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

• Bachelor’s (and higher) degree in Electric Engineering with focus on power system engineering.

• 4 - 5 years of experience in power system protection, engineering studies, or related consulting services.

• Strong understanding of power system protection principles, protective relays, short-circuit analysis, and protection coordination.

• Experience working with Inverter-based resources (IBRs) including solar, wind, and battery energy storage systems. Experience with conventional generation facilities is a plus.

• Familiarity with Digital Fault Recorders (DFRs), disturbance monitoring systems, SCADA, and substation communication systems.

• Experience with power system analysis and protection software such as ASPEN OneLiner, CAPE, ETAP, PSSE, PSCAD, SEL Quickset, and GE Enervista UR Setup.

• Experience working with SEL equipment, software, and/or developing programming files using SEL Quickset.

• General understanding of NERC reliability standards and their application to protection systems and maintenance.

• Strong analytical problem solving, technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to work independently, and to collaborate with clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Lead the Change!
